mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.type, c.order_id AS "orderId", c.current_cs_id AS "currentCsId", COALESCE(cs.user_name, cs.nick_name, cs.phone, CAST(cs.id AS text)) AS "currentCsName", client_user.id AS "userId", COALESCE(client_user.nick_name, client_user.user_name, client_user.phone, CAST(client_user.id AS text)) AS "userName", c.last_message AS "lastMessage", c.last_message_time AS "lastMessageTime", c.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN users cs ON cs.id = c.current_cs_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cm.conversation_id, MIN(cm.user_id) AS user_id FROM conversation_members cm INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = cm.user_id WHERE u.role_code = 2 GROUP BY cm.conversation_id ) client_map ON client_map.conversation_id = c.id LEFT JOIN users client_user ON client_user.id = client_map.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id FROM conversation_members WHERE user_id IN (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}) GROUP BY conversation_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) = 2 LIMIT 1

SELECT client_user.id AS userId, c.current_cs_id AS currentCsId, c.id FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN users cs ON cs.id = c.current_cs_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cm.conversation_id, MIN(cm.user_id) AS user_id FROM conversation_members cm INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = cm.user_id WHERE u.role_code = 2 GROUP BY cm.conversation_id ) client_map ON client_map.conversation_id = c.id LEFT JOIN users client_user ON client_user.id = client_map.user_id
ORDER BY c.last_message_time DESC NULLS LAST, c.id DESC
